story.fullStory:
Tina Turner's "Nutbush City Limits" — original release 2008. "Nutbush City Limits" is a semi-autobiographical song written by American singer and actress Tina Turner which commemorates her rural hometown of Nutbush in Haywood County, Tennessee, United States.

Originally released as a single on United Artists Records in August 1973, it is one of the last hits that husband-wife R&B duo Ike & Tina Turner released together.

In the years since, "Nutbush City Limits" has been performed by popular artists such as Bob Seger and The Silver Bullet Band, AC/DC or the Alvin Lee band in their album RX5.

Nutbush City Limits was released in 2008.
